description: This Java class 'UpdateManager' is a servlet handling HTTP POST requests to update manager information, including updating the manager's profile with optional image upload and redirecting or forwarding based on success or failure.

classes.name: UpdateManager
classes.description: A servlet for processing updates to manager profiles, including handling image uploads and directing flow accordingly.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update manager profile information, including optional image upload, and forwards to appropriate views based on success or failure.
